status: machinery pilot, no RL improvement or financial alpha demonstrated

config.claim: training-path development; not evidence of improved market alpha

limitations: Original training manifests were emitted at run end, before the first Git commit.
SFT used a scripted teacher and 84 examples from 12 synthetic tasks.
RLOO had four groups of four trajectories, only two groups with nonzero reward variation.
Original RLOO token traces retain decoded text; later code additionally logs raw completion IDs.
Constant-reward numerical centering was hardened after v1. Its actual two constant groups had exact-zero advantages.
Base failed strict JSON because it emitted fenced JSON; apply the same format-robust parser to all actors in the next comparison.
SFT and RLOO greedy actions and rewards are identical on the six development tasks.
Weights were updated and save/reload matched exactly; this does not establish improved research or generalization.
